from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashDisclosure(BaseModel):
    """A cash and cash equivalents figure reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric cash amount as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the cash line item in the statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the cash figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_disclosures: list[CashDisclosure]
